series.title: Environmental Engineering
series.statusStatement: Active (EMST OPM series register, as of 2026-10-23).
series.qualificationStandardVersion: Professional Engineering Positions basic requirements (ABET degree or alternatives)
series.educationNote: from EMST's series record; not yet checked against the OPM qualification standard, so confirm with the HR office

generalCompetencies: not mapped in this release (X9 USA Hire and FWCI parts not built; WP-09 open item 6)

roles.functionStatement: Design and certify engineered environmental systems and analyses within the scope of professional licensure.

x4.reviewStatus: unreviewed agent candidate (not reviewed by a person)

bands.indicativeBand: GS-5 to GS-7 (entry); GS-9 to GS-11 (journey)

majorDuties.duty: Practice within licensure scope and responsible charge

tasks.statement: Determine whether an assigned task falls within the scope of one's licence or certification, referring out-of-scope work to a qualified professional
Keep the records licensing rules require for sealed work, including review notes and the basis for each certification

majorDuties.duty: Issue environmental permits and resource-use authorizations as the deciding authority

tasks.statement: Review a permit application for administrative and technical completeness, issuing a deficiency notice that lists each missing element and its basis
Derive permit limits and conditions from the applicable technical standards and the facility's technical record, documenting the calculation basis for each limit
Draft a permit and its fact sheet so that each condition is measurable, enforceable and traceable to its legal or technical basis

majorDuties.duty: Draft enforceable, implementable binding instruments

tasks.statement: Write policy or instrument language that states each obligation, obligated party, deadline and verification method so that compliance can be determined
Review a proposed policy or instrument for consistency with governing law, existing instruments and agency authority, listing each conflict found
Test a draft instrument with the staff and parties who must implement it, revising terms they cannot carry out or verify

majorDuties.duty: Build, calibrate and validate predictive and simulation models of environmental systems

tasks.statement: Simulate ecosystem response to alternative land-use and climate scenarios, documenting scenario assumptions and the sensitivity of results to each.
Build a predictive model of fire risk, pest outbreak or water availability, validating it on years or areas withheld from fitting.

majorDuties.duty: Supervise automated and AI-assisted process control in environmental operations

tasks.statement: Run a treatment process in safe manual operation when automation or communications fail, adapting the manual operating procedure to conditions
Monitor automated control loops and alarms on a treatment process, checking automated responses against field observations of process condition
Override an automated control action when process indicators show it is driving the system toward a permit or safety limit, documenting the decision

majorDuties.duty: Investigate and manage emerging contaminants across media

tasks.statement: Interpret emerging-contaminant results against current and proposed criteria, stating how the conclusions change if the criteria change.

majorDuties.duty: Protect operational technology at environmental utilities and facilities

tasks.statement: Maintain an inventory of connected control and monitoring assets with their network zone, remote-access paths and owner.
Run an incident-response drill that switches a plant or monitoring network to manual operation, recording the time to a safe state and the gaps found.

majorDuties.duty: Assess human health risks from environmental exposures

tasks.statement: Conduct an exposure assessment for an environmental contaminant, identifying pathways, receptors and exposure concentrations with documented assumptions.
Calculate health risks from environmental exposures with the methods the applicable requirements specify, stating the uncertainty of each estimate.

majorDuties.duty: Evaluate model fitness-for-purpose and validate against independent evidence

tasks.statement: Identify which inputs drive a model's predictions with an interpretation method suited to the model, testing whether the drivers are ecologically plausible.
Explain a model's main drivers and failure conditions to managers with visuals that show what the model does and does not capture.

majorDuties.duty: Deliver environmental projects to budget, schedule and quality

tasks.statement: Prepare progress reports for leadership from the project's tracking records, stating schedule and budget variance.
Break a large project into phased work packages with deliverables, dependencies and decision points

majorDuties.duty: Direct and evaluate applicant- or contractor-prepared environmental documents

tasks.statement: Document the agency's independent evaluation of a sponsor-prepared document before adoption, recording what was verified and what was changed

Exercise responsible charge over subordinates' professional work, directing and reviewing it so that the sealing professional can attest to it
Keep the records licensing rules require for sealed work, including review notes and the basis for each certification
Certify a professional deliverable under seal only after personally reviewing the work, including any AI-assisted portions, to the standard of care

tasks.statement: Simulate ecosystem response to alternative land-use and climate scenarios, documenting scenario assumptions and the sensitivity of results to each.
Present model outputs to stakeholders for an adaptive management decision, stating the conditions under which the projections should not be trusted.
Build a predictive model of fire risk, pest outbreak or water availability, validating it on years or areas withheld from fitting.

tasks.statement: Recommend interim response and treatment options for an emerging contaminant, comparing performance evidence, cost and handling of residuals.
Interpret emerging-contaminant results against current and proposed criteria, stating how the conclusions change if the criteria change.
Plan an investigation of an emerging contaminant, specifying media, sampling locations, analytical methods and their reporting limits.

Calculate health risks from environmental exposures with the methods the applicable requirements specify, stating the uncertainty of each estimate.

tasks.statement: Document the agency's independent evaluation of a sponsor-prepared document before adoption, recording what was verified and what was changed
Evaluate a sponsor-prepared environmental document for adequacy and objectivity, returning specific deficiencies the preparer must correct before adoption

majorDuties.duty: Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions

tasks.statement: Brief an authorizing official on the uncertainty of an analysis in decision terms, such as the risk of a wrong call and the value of more information.
Set organizational conventions for uncertainty language and visuals, testing whether decision-makers interpret them correctly.
